posts: Chain signatures still ask users to 'confirm' payloads they can't read. Show the actual intent — token, amount, destination — in plain language and we kill blind signing for good. #chainsignatures #wallets

replies.text: Adoption also tracks signatures. If chain abstraction still means three approvals across two wallets, no liquidity cycle saves it. Fix the signing flow first.
That 1.6% IL is invisible if your wallet just shows an LP balance. Wallets should surface fee APR minus IL inline — rebalancing blind is a UX failure, not a user error.
